'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jonathan Dansbury DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Dansbury]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
